name: SM_Door_Barred_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset: the joinery needs its own ambient occlusion and wear
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: dark ledged plank door in an oak frame with a barred light at head height, 0.95 x 2.0 m, standing against the wall
known_weaknesses: The light is a dark panel behind the bars, not an opening, and the door does not open. The 1997 picture shows blue glints in the grille that are not reproduced. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs or nails are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only.
source_note: the .blend holds the game mesh with its baked set; the dense boards it was baked from are rebuilt by the script (they were removed after the bake to keep the file small)
